dedupe_keys.name: a dataset for cyber threat intelligence modeling of connected autonomous vehicles

description: A dataset for cyber threat intelligence modeling of connected autonomous vehicles is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yinghui Wang et al. Cyber attacks pose significant threats to connected autonomous vehicles in intelligent transportation systems. Cyber threat intelligence (CTI), which involves collecting and analyzing cyber threat information, offers a promising approach to addressing emerging vehicle cyber threats and enabling proactive security defenses. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: TXT. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2326469 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
